headline: CMS INDUSLAW advises Anveshan on ₹150 cr Series B
sum: D2C foods brand Anveshan raised ₹150 cr Series B led by Vertex Ventures and IFC, with Swiggy co-founder Sriharsha Majety participating.
detail: Anveshan Farm Technologies raised ₹150 crore in a Series B led by Vertex Ventures and IFC Co-Invest, with participation from Swiggy co-founder Sriharsha Majety and existing investors. CMS INDUSLAW advised Anveshan, with tax support. Anveshan makes clean, traceable foods including A2 ghee, cold-pressed oils and honey.

sources.name: Bar & Bench — Dealstreet
sources.blurb: “Anveshan Farm Technologies…has raised ₹150 crore from a Series B…led by Vertex Ventures and IFC Co-Invest, with participation from Swiggy co-founder Sriharsha Majety…” — confirms the CMS INDUSLAW team.
